item.title: Exxon, Chevron warn fuel prices to stay high as war disrupts refining
item.description: Retail gasoline prices are only 10% below May's peak, despite a 26% drop in West Texas Intermediate.

item.title: Spain builds 1,600-foot sea barrier at Ceuta border after EU warns of mass crossings
item.description: Italian Premier Giorgia Meloni has threatened to suspend Italy's open-border Schengen agreement with Spain.

item.title: Mega-war emerges as Mideast and European conflicts converge, drawing in more nations
item.description: "The Iran and Ukraine wars may be connecting."

item.title: Elon Musk's fortune drops to pre-SpaceX IPO levels after market slump
item.description: Musk's wealth, which peaked at about $1.33 trillion on June 16, now stands at $684 billion.
